correctness.rationale: Headline claim is a finite computational existence certificate, not an infinitary theorem, and is framed honestly as such. Definition used matches Huova-Karhumaki: blocks length m are 2-abelian equivalent iff first letters equal, last letters equal, and internal digram multisets agree (m=1 vacuous, so 000/111). Auditor hand-verified verify.c: prefix array P[k][i]=#{pairs starting at j<i}; digram count in [l,r) is P[r-1]-P[l]; block windows ca=P[s+m-1]-P[s], cb=P[s+2m-1]-P[s+m], cc=P[e-1]-P[s+2m] are exactly the m-1 internal digrams; m=1 handled as 000/111; m=2 direct-compare path avoids placeholder columns; boundary-letter early exits check firsts (w[s],w[s+m],w[s+2m]) and lasts (w[s+m-1],w[s+2m-1],w[e-1]); loop over all (e,m) with 3m<=e enumerates every (s,m) factor. Auditor rebuilt verify.c from source and independently replayed: OK length 200000 checks 6666633333 (=sum_{e<=200000} floor(e/3)) for BOTH words, plus 5000- and 20000-prefix replays OK, regression positives 001001001->CUBE s=0 m=3 and 000->CUBE s=0 m=1 both fire, and independent brute_check.py (Counter-based, no prefix sums) agrees on 1500-prefixes and 2000-prefixes. Word files verified: 200000 binary symbols each (+newline, 200001 bytes), seed1 100001 zeros/99999 ones with claimed head/tail exact, seed0 binary with distinct hash. Prior checker window bug (ca/cb over wrong windows) is documented as repaired and the repaired file is what was audited. Obstruction-profile totals are internally consistent (149086 block rows = histogram sum, 75763 backtracks, 1178 distinct arms, max m=33707, summary row matches) but digram-signature correctness row-by-row was not exhaustively re-derived; it is secondary to the headline witness and honestly labeled as search-trace data, not an intrinsic census.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp argument. Huova-Karhumaki arXiv:1104.4273 (verified live 2026-09-08) explicitly leaves open whether 2-abelian cubes are avoidable over 2 or 3 letters and cites only a binary 2-abelian-cube-free word of length 100000; no >=120000 or 200000 witness and no obstruction dataset. Exact-phrase arXiv search for '2-abelian cube-free' returns only that paper. Rao-Rosenfeld arXiv:1507.02581 studies long k-abelian repetitions with period restrictions (e.g. abelian cubes of period>=2 unavoidable binary; 3-abelian squares period>=3 avoidable binary) and gives no full all-period binary 2-abelian-cube-free word of length 100000+. Glen-Halldorsson-Kitaev concerns abelian (not 2-abelian) crucial-word extremal non-extendable lengths; Cassaigne-Richomme-Saari-Zamboni proves infinitary bounded-complexity existence with no explicit long 2-abelian-cube witness or record. None mechanically implies an explicit certified 200000-length binary 2-abelian-cube-free word plus obstruction statistics. The doubled record plus certificate is therefore new.

value.rationale: Strongest headline claim judged separately from unfinished survey aspects: two explicit certified binary 2-abelian-cube-free words of length 200000 doubling the published 100000 benchmark on the open side of the recognized 2-vs-3 threshold. Object (binary 2-abelian-cube-free words) and question (smallest alphabet avoiding 2-abelian cubes) predate computation (Huova-Karhumaki 2011); the 200000 length is 2x the literature benchmark, not an arbitrary hour-budget slice; the value was not known or mechanically implied by cited existence/restriction theorems; a future researcher can reasonably need the precise word (longest test word for 2-abelian algorithms, morphism-preservation conjectures, threshold studies) and the obstruction histogram as search-density data. Finite-benchmark form is eligible and no infinite-avoidability claim is made. Certification strengthens but is not substituted for value. Passes the narrow-exact-invariant clause: motivated natural object, unknown non-mechanical value, retrievable datum.

decisive_checks: Rebuilt verify.c with gcc and ran full O(n^2/6) replay on both 200000-bit words: OK length 200000 checks 6666633333 each (matches sum_{e} floor(e/3)); exit 0.
Ran 5000- and 20000-prefix replays under repaired checker: OK (checks 4165833 at 5000; 66663333 at 20000).
Regression positives fire: 001001001 -> CUBE s=0 m=3; 000 -> CUBE s=0 m=1.
Independent brute_check.py agrees: both 1500-prefixes OK; logged 2000-prefix + 40/40 random-word first-cube agreement (crosscheck.log).

Word-file audit: 200001 bytes (word+newline), 200000 binary symbols, seed1 100001x0/99999x1, head 11001100100101001011 and tail ...1011001011001010010100 exact; sha256 hashes match DRAFT and research_report.
Obstruction consistency: 149086 block rows = histogram total; 1178 histogram rows; max arm 33707; 75763 backtracks; summary row pos=200000.

residual_risks: Full 200000-bit certificate replay is O(n^2/6) ~46 s in C; future replays need a C toolchain, not pure Python (numpy vectorized audit documented as too slow).

Obstruction digram signatures row-by-row depend on search.c logging path; auditor checked totals/histogram/max/sample parsing but did not independently re-derive all 149086 signatures; profile is correctly labeled as greedy-search trace, not intrinsic density census.
Finite witness pressures but does not resolve the open infinite 2-vs-3 avoidability threshold; DRAFT states this limitation explicitly.
Only binary alphabet tested; no ternary comparison.
